notes: Searches used: 0. Fetches used: 45 (20 directory entries and 25 club websites). No rate limiting seen. All 20 entries are verdict publish; none were hidden, duplicated or out of area. Status counts: active 1, probably_active 8, unknown 11. Eight clubs are marked INACTIVE in their directory entries (Retail, Aerospace, Consulting WUCC, Real Estate WUREC, Sports Business, WUPP, Future of Cities, Wellness Board). Per the brief they were written as unknown records with no summary, so they are held back. Two of them have club sites that show newer dated activity: the Aerospace site lists a February 2026 event and the Future of Cities site lists a February 20, 2026 conference. The orchestrator should decide whether to lift the inactive flag for those two. Three full records have status unknown and will show as unknown: WUEC, Growth Equity and USS. Unreadable sites: Growth Equity (HTTP 404 on every URL tried), WUREC (HTTP 404) and USS (TLS certificate error); these are listed under blocked as dead or unreadable, not as bot blocks. Wharton Together's directory email looks like a personal Gmail address, so it was not recorded. Wellness Board co-chair names and emails were not recorded. The Finance club site uses F26 for Fall 2026; that reading is the basis for last_sign_of_life 2026-09. Directory facts came through WebFetch's summarizer, not raw JSON, so exact dates, emails and URLs deserve a spot check before publishing. Future of Cities is an annual conference run by graduate students; after review it may be better as not_a_group or as a separate entry.
